Thanks for the ping. Initial notes after a quick look at logs and trace samples:
- No model version rollouts for acme/production in the last 72h.
- There are a handful of long-running calls with unusually large prompt sizes (10-20x median tokens) coming from a small set of request_ids. Possible client-side regression sending larger context.
- KV cache hit rate for that tenant has dropped from ~96% to ~62% coincident with the spike window — suggests cache prefix churn or new prompt patterns bypassing cache.

Immediate asks (I can run these if you confirm):
1) Dump sample request bodies for the top 20 high-cost request_ids (I can attach a redacted log extract).
2) Run a short correlator query (per-minute) for: token_count, model_variant, kv_cache_hit, p50/p95 latency, and cost units.
3) Temporarily enable an alert: threshold p95 > 500ms for acme/production, notify oncall and sofia.

I can have 1+2 by EOD. Not sure if this is infra autoscaling related — Dylan, can you check GPU utilization and any preemption events on the dedicated instances serving acme?

- Marcus
